headline: Binance customers have pulled a net $4.7B since withdrawals reopened, with more coins due to reopen Tuesday as US voters go to the midterms.

market.asOf: Read about 19:57 UTC Mon 2 Nov (02:57 Tue Bangkok) from the Alternative.me dashboard. Use the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 37 (Fear), up from 34 yesterday, on the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index

stories.title: Binance net withdrawals reach about $4.7B; more coins reopen Tuesday
stories.summary: Since Binance reopened withdrawals on Sunday after its record hack, customers have taken out about $4.7B more than they put in. Binance says that is about 3% of its assets and that money is also flowing back in. Withdrawals for more networks and coins restart on Tuesday 3 Nov.
points: Net outflows are about $4.7B, about 3% of the roughly $157B in assets Binance holds by its own estimate, per Bloomberg.
Reuters puts net outflows at $4.72B, with $2.7B of customer money coming in since Sunday.
Rival exchanges gained over 24 hours: OKX $284.9M, Gate $93.2M and Bybit $29.3M, per DefiLlama data cited by Reuters.
Binance says more networks and coins reopen on Tuesday 3 Nov and has not yet published the list, per Bitcoin Magazine.
A broader reserve snapshot is taken on 4 Nov and its proof takes 40 to 50 hours, per Bitcoin Magazine.

sources.label: Bloomberg via Insurance Journal: $4.7B net outflows

stories.title: Hackers spread the stolen Binance funds across about 12,000 wallets; the CFTC chair uses it to push oversight
stories.summary: Blockchain firm Elliptic says the North Korea-linked hackers moved the funds through about 12,000 wallets in under four days. About 44% is frozen, but over $3B is still in their hands. The head of the US CFTC is citing the theft to argue that offshore exchanges need federal supervision.
points: Elliptic puts the theft at $6.43B, with about $2.85B (44%) frozen or seized, per Decrypt.
About $3.24B is still in hacker-linked addresses, including 18,270 BTC that have not moved, per Decrypt.
Circle froze $823M of stolen USDC according to Decrypt; Reuters reports Circle froze more than $1.1B.
CFTC Chair Michael Selig is pointing to the hack to press for federal oversight of crypto exchanges, per PYMNTS.

sources.label: Decrypt: a new wallet every 25 seconds
PYMNTS: Selig presses for exchange oversight

stories.title: Morgan Stanley cuts Coinbase to Underweight as bitcoin funds see heavy outflows
stories.summary: Morgan Stanley downgraded Coinbase and more than halved its price target, citing weaker trading and uncertainty after the Binance hack. US spot bitcoin funds had a big outflow on Friday.
points: Morgan Stanley moved Coinbase to Underweight from Equal Weight and cut its target to $120 from $258, per TheStreet.
Coinbase shares closed at $143.54 on 30 Oct, down 10.62% that day, per TheStreet.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had $643.3M of net outflows on 30 Oct, per ad-hoc-news.

briefs.title: Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin hacked for $40M+
briefs.summary: Mercado Bitcoin paused deposits and withdrawals after wallets on at least 10 blockchains were drained; Tether froze $4.5M, per CoinDesk.
